user.title: Tuya Device Inspector
user.description: Enter the credentials from your Tuya IoT Platform cloud project. Nothing is sent to your devices; this integration only reads their descriptions.

data_description.access_id: Your cloud project's Access ID, sometimes shown as Client ID.
data_description.data_center: The region your Smart Life account is registered in. The wrong one will fail to authenticate.

device.title: Choose a device
device.description: Pick the device you want to inspect. Add the integration again to inspect another one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tuya API. Check your network and the selected data center.
error.invalid_auth: Tuya rejected these credentials. Check the Access ID and Access Secret, and that the data center matches your account.
error.no_devices: No devices found in this cloud project. Link your Smart Life account on the Devices tab of the Tuya IoT Platform.

abort.already_configured: This device is already being inspected.

export.name: Export device details
export.description: Collect a Tuya device's description and write it to a file you can download and attach to an issue. Runs for every inspected device unless one is named.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Limit the export to a single inspected device. Leave empty to export all of them.
